'''Kon Yel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A surveyor, Yel enlisted the help of a Republic-allied individual to prevent a meltdown at the ruined [[Taris ChemWorks Factory]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Biography==
A [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Kon Yel lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he worked for the Republic Resettlement, part of the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]], as a surveyor. He investigated the ruins of the [[Taris ChemWorks Factory]] near [[Lake Brell]] and discoverd that the plant was close to a meltdown and collapse.<ref name="Burnoff" />

When he returned to [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]], the nearest Republic outpost, and contacted his employers, Yel informed them that the meltdown would render the area completely uninhabitable. As the area was too dangerous to send in a team, Yel's superiors told the Kel Dor that they would prepare to evacuate. However, the transmission was overheard by a Republic-allied individual, who asked to help. Yel informed the individual that the only way to avoid a meltdown was to perform a burnoff, which meant destroying the piles of chemicals with small directed fires. As there were no teams available to perform the burnoff, the individual offered to do it personally. Braving the rakghouls that inhabited the ruined plant, the individual managed to destroy the chemicals and secure the area. Thanking the individual, Yel contacted the project and informed them of the good news.<ref name="Burnoff" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kon Yel was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears on the Republic version of Taris in Waypoint Station Draay, where he gives Republic players the mission "Burnoff".<ref name="Burnoff" />
